question: Refer to the exhibits. ESXi-Server is associated to the blade server. A VLAN is added to Trunk-A. The VLAN is missing on the vNIC of ESXi-Server. Which action should be taken to add the VLAN to the vNIC?
context:
Exhibit 1: Service Template ESXi-Server (updating template) - vNIC template list includes Trunk-A.
Exhibit 2: vNIC Template Trunk-A - Template Type: Initial Template.
options: Change the template type of Trunk-A to an updating template.
Remove the VLAN from the Trunk-A template and add the VLAN again.
Change the template type of ESXi-Server to an updating template.
Remove both templates and recreate them as updating templates.
